writing.prompt: Deep reading in a distracted age
writing.sample:
Notifications arrive every few minutes, and each one invites us to switch tasks. In such an environment, deep reading—the ability to stay with a demanding text for more than a few minutes—is becoming both rarer and more valuable. It trains attention, helps us understand complex ideas, and gives us space to think independently rather than react to whatever appears on the screen.

Students can protect the habit in simple ways. First, set aside a fixed period each day for reading with the phone in another room. Second, choose texts that require effort, and take brief notes to stay engaged. Third, treat reading as a conversation: ask questions, mark passages, and summarize what you have read. These practices may feel slow at first, but they build the mental endurance that a distracted world is quietly eroding.
outline: 开头：通知不断打断注意力，深度阅读因此更稀缺、更有价值。
主体：深度阅读训练注意力、帮助理解复杂观点、留出独立思考空间。
方法：固定阅读时段并远离手机；选择有难度的文本；做简短笔记、提问与复述。
结尾：这些看似慢的习惯，能恢复被碎片化生活侵蚀的专注力。
writing.rubric: 15 分制练习评分：任务回应 5 分（是否说明重要性并给出方法）、组织 4 分（结构清晰、衔接自然）、语言 6 分（语法、词汇、句式；少量错误不严重影响理解可给较高分）。

translation.reference: Chinese tea culture has a long history. For Chinese people, tea is not only a beverage but also a way of life. The process of making and tasting tea encourages people to slow down and communicate with friends. Today, more and more young people are learning the art of tea, hoping to find inner peace in a fast-paced life. Tea is not just a flavor; it is also a way of welcoming guests and a kind of life wisdom.
points: 源远流长：has a long history / dates back centuries
生活方式：a way of life
泡茶、品茶：making and tasting tea / brewing and appreciating tea
与朋友交流：communicate / talk with friends
越来越多：more and more / a growing number of
茶艺：the art of tea / tea ceremony
快节奏的生活：a fast-paced life
内心的平静：inner peace / inner calm
待客之道：a way of welcoming guests / hospitality
生活智慧：life wisdom / wisdom for living
translation.rubric: 15 分制练习评分：内容忠实 7 分（信息完整、无明显漏译/误译）、语言准确 5 分（语法、搭配、拼写）、流畅得体 3 分（衔接、语域、可读性）。

gradingNotes: 客观题按字母判分；大小写不敏感。若学生在选词填空处写单词而非字母，单词正确可视为正确，但需在报告中注明。
中文注解按“正确 / 部分正确 / 错误 / 无法辨认”四档判定；无法辨认时不要猜，标“？”。
手写字母若同时像两个选项（如 B/D），先结合笔画描述，仍不确定则在报告中请学生确认。
翻译/写作为练习参考分，不是官方 CET-6 分数。

vocab-errors-01.title: 词汇巩固 · 错词文章 01

items.context: In a world full of distraction
items.note: 名词；此处指干扰/使人分心的事物。

items.context: the ability to focus is crucial for learning

items.note: 动词；吸收/理解信息。写“到手”算错误（那是 obtain/acquire）。
此处作动词“处理/加工”。只写名词“过程”算部分正确；要说明语境义。
名词；store in memory = 存入记忆。
动词；recall facts = 回忆事实。不要和 recover（恢复）混。

items.context: their ability to remember often begins to decline
preserve the habits that support learning
items.note: 动词；保持/保存。写“坚持”算错误（那是 persist/insist）。

items.context: Teachers can highlight the most important ideas
items.note: 动词；强调/突出。只写“高亮”算部分正确（偏界面用语）。

items.context: Those who constantly switch between tasks
If you genuinely want to learn
items.note: 副词；此处是“真正地/真心地”。只写“真诚地”可算部分正确，但语境义应说明。

gradingNotes: 这是词汇注解题，没有 A/B/C/D 客观分；按 12 个词逐条判“正确 / 部分正确 / 错误 / 无法辨认”。
判定标准是“文章语境中的意思”，不是词典第一义；例如 process 这里必须是动词“处理”，写“过程”算部分正确。
近义表达可接受；例如 absorb 写“吸收/理解/消化”、preserve 写“保持/保存”、highlight 写“强调/突出”都算正确。
如果学生把中文写在文章右侧留白而不是编号表，用文章里的编号定位；编号表为空不等于没作答。
字迹看不清时标“无法辨认”，不要猜；可对照 article 的 context 句。
